title: ericoides distans
intro: Ericoides distans, commonly known as the "Yerba de la Playa" or "Beach Sandwort", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Ericoides distans include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
